name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention. '3b' = dispatch idx 0x3B into the per-event handler table at 0x51B91 (this entry at 0x51C7D), a real domain ID (handler slot), NOT an address residue (the function's own address is 0x35641, unrelated). 'ch26' = chapter 26, a meaningful chapter ID (01-30). 'ai_ctrl' accurately describes the body (disarms the per-char AI control flag). Consistent with sibling handlers _3a/_3c in the same file.
purpose: Chapter-26 tile-step event handler (dispatch idx 0x3B): when a non-enemy char steps on the trigger tile, disarm the per-char AI control flag for 6 chars 0x27..0x2C.
logic_summary: Tile-step ABI: arg = stepping char id (read from [ESP+0x4]). Indexes data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr[stepping_char_id] (80-byte stride: EAX = id*5<<4 = id*0x50) and tests the team field at struct offset +6. If team != 0 (non-enemy: npc/player; team==0 enemy is skipped), calls fd2_set_combat_aux_block_byte_d_low4_for_char_range(0x27, 0x2C, 0), writing low-nibble value 0 into pCombat_aux_block[0xD] for every char in the inclusive range 0x27..0x2C (6 chars), i.e. disarms their AI control flag. No dialog. __CHK(0x10) stack-frame prologue.

params.name: stepping_char_id
params.semantics: Tile-step ABI argument (stack [ESP+0x4]) = runtime index of the char that stepped on the trigger tile. Used to index data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr and read that char's team field to gate the AI-disarm.
params.reason: Accurately names the value (stepping char id under the tile-step ABI); no address residue, not a generic param_N. Matches the storage Stack[0x4] and the disassembly MOV EDX,[ESP+0x4].

Callee fd2_set_combat_aux_block_byte_d_low4_for_char_range writes low 4 bits of arg3 into pCombat_aux_block[0xD] for the inclusive char range; arg3=0 disarms the flag.
